text:
Asha (CSM): Team — Skyline dedicated go-live Friday. Need final quota matrix, autoscale rules, and a tight loadtest plan. Renewal review same week so first-72h telemetry + customer check-in mandatory.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Copy. What steady and burst profiles should I validate?
Rina (SRE): Suggested: idle 50 qps, steady 200 qps, short bursts to 800 qps (1-5m). Test recipe: smoke (5m), progressive ramp (25m), extended soak (60m).
Ben (Solutions Eng): I'll build the scripts. Planning a T-24h warmup to prime KV/prefix caches and tokenizers.
Ola (Support): I'll be on-call for the window. Please drop alert thresholds and the support checklist here. I'll spin up a dedicated huddle if anything trips.
Marta (Product): Request: add a per-route cost cap flag and a simple circuit-breaker for premium endpoints. Also want an opt-in tiny UX feedback card sent to the product contact at T+48h.
Asha (CSM): Good. I'll message the renewal owner and attach the enablement deck + short survey. We'll label Skyline high-touch for 14 days.
Rina (SRE): Alerts + fallback: error_rate > 0.75% for 60s -> warn, p95_latency > 600ms for 90s -> scale, p99_latency > 1200ms -> page. If p95 > 850ms for 60s, route to quantized-xxs model pool.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Load command I'll run:

```
./conductor --target https://private.api.redwood/skyline --rps 200 --duration 60m --pattern progressive --header "x-customer:skyline"
```

Ben (Solutions Eng): KV prime:

```
python tools/prime_kv.py --account skyline --corpus skyline_prompts.json --threads 10
```

Rina (SRE): Autoscale policy draft (we'll tune after smoke):

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 16
  primary_metric: p95_latency_ms
  target_value: 420
  eval_window_sec: 60
  cooldown_sec: 90
  secondary_metric: cpu_utilization_pct
  cpu_threshold: 75
```

Ola (Support): I'll assemble the support playbook: where to check logs, how to flip fallback, who to page, token-cost dashboard link, and quick remediation steps. I'll also publish the CSAT + 3-question post-go-live survey.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled 2024-09-06T21:00Z — ticket CS-8190 :white_check_mark:
Ben (Solutions Eng): Proposed windows (UTC):
- Thu 02:00: KV warmup (10m)
- Thu 03:30: smoke (5m)
- Thu 04:00: progressive ramp (25m)
- Fri 01:30: soak (60m) + verification and gradual traffic shift
Asha (CSM): Ops reviewed windows and approved. Action items: 1) Rina: commit autoscale policy + add runbook link (ops/runbooks/skyline-onboard.md). 2) Ben: upload load scripts + raw metrics to shared drive. 3) Ola: publish support playbook + CSAT link. 4) Asha: send renewal owner note + enablement deck + feedback card.
Asha (CSM): Also adding a quick pre-mortem doc to the thread and asking the account's engineering lead for a 15m sync immediately post-soak.
Ben (Solutions Eng): I'll tag scripts with the exact request headers and seed prompt list so we mirror production prefixes.
Rina (SRE): I'll enable token-level cost dashboards for Skyline and add a short-run alert to watch for cost-per-token spike > 2x baseline.
Ola (Support): I'll create a one-page triage sheet and post it here when ready.
Asha (CSM): Ping this thread when each item is done. High priority given renewal window. :rocket:
